about: ONE CAST for the first release (twelve ports, 793 to 805; later spans are carried where the places files have them). Made 7 Oct 2026 by a script from Assets/Kapman/Game/Data/places/*.json (the people), encounters/*.json (the cards' actors), encounters/npc_roles_793.json (which roles one person holds at a time: 'fixed'), goods_793.json (the kinds of goods) and Bake/content/card_rules.py (which cards can open in the release, and where). A CHECK FILE, outside Assets: Design/fixes/one_cast.md says how the game should read it. cast: one row for each port, role and span of years: the ONE person of the places files a card's actor of that role at that port is, in those years. office true: a role one person holds at a time (a card's fixed actor of this role is this person); office false: a trade several follow (only a card whose note names the person speaks through them; any other actor of the role is a stranger). alias true: the places file calls the person something else (places_role) and this row gives them the office the cards ask for. cards: the ids of the cards that can open in the first release and speak through this person in this part; cards_later: cards named at this port that are shut in the release (their years lie outside it). title: what the person is called after their name, from npc_roles_793.json by their places role ('Aldgrim the toll man'). from, to: the years they hold the part; at_port: the years they are at the port at all (a person tells prices for as long as they are at the port). tells_prices and tells_goods: whether the person tells prices of other markets, and of which goods by their trade ('all', or ids of goods_793.json); tells_as: the market's old word for such a teller (wording_793.json person.quay) that this person now takes the place of. gaps: an office the cards ask for at a port where nobody of the places file holds it, with the cards that ask. aboard: the seats of the ship. strangers: roles a card forges a new face for each time, by design. Nothing here is invented: every person, year and role is the places files'; the rows marked 'by hand' say why.
goods_kinds: tells_goods lists ids of goods_793.json; 'all' means every good of a told snapshot
